provenance.temporal_resolution: daily (time_standard LST); an hourly API also exists
processing: POWER API v2.10.3 (sources MERRA2, GEOSIT, SYN1DEG, FLASHFLUX, POWER), community AG, point (-79.8400, -3.3750)
AOI centre and 4 corners returned identical series: one POWER cell covers the AOI
fill value -999.0 -> missing (empty cell); units in column suffix, as published
provenance.notes: time_standard LST. Columns: t2m_c: T2M [C] Temperature at 2 Meters; t2m_max_c: T2M_MAX [C] Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum; t2m_min_c: T2M_MIN [C] Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum; rh2m_pct: RH2M [%] Relative Humidity at 2 Meters; prectotcorr_mm: PRECTOTCORR [mm/day] Precipitation Corrected; ws2m_ms: WS2M [m/s] Wind Speed at 2 Meters; allsky_sfc_sw_dwn_mj_m2: ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN [MJ/m^2/day] All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance. RH stays in % as published (convert to 0..1 in the engine).
